notes.subject: נטעו נטעים
notes.rationale: verb and participle of the same root stand side by side — planted the planters — the doubling is kept in English.

notes.subject: וְחִלֵּלוּ
notes.rationale: piel of חלל: literally 'make common, treat as ordinary' (thus enjoy the fruit) vs the darker reading 'profane'; the literal make-common is kept.

notes.subject: the fruit
notes.rationale: the object of 'treat-as-common' is not in the Hebrew and is supplied in brackets.

notes.subject: to virgin Israel
notes.rationale: the verse addresses the feminine addressee of 31:4 with the promise 'again you shall plant'.

translation: Again you shall plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria; planters have planted, and shall treat-as-common ⟨the fruit⟩.
